summary: Brains, Minds and Machines is a three-week advanced research training course at the Marine Biological Laboratory (MBL) in Woods Hole, Massachusetts, United States, on intelligence at the meeting point of computer science and neuroscience. It is appropriate for graduate students, postdocs and faculty in these fields. The 2027 course runs from 8 to 29 August 2027, and applications are due by 29 March 2027.
highlights: Appropriate for graduate students, postdocs and faculty in computer science or neuroscience.
